verdict.rationale: Amplitude's first-party docs state that Experiment SDKs exist for flagging and testing features across web, mobile, and backend, so developers can build against official SDKs. The Experiment management API and a published OpenAPI spec back this up. The SDK evidence is a single overview line, with no language list, SDK reference depth, or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: per-language SDK listing and reference docs, independent or hands-on confirmation of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use Experiment SDKs to flag and test features across web, mobile, and backend.
Use the Experiment management API to programmatically create and control flags and experiments.
